effect_description_eng:
＜Barrier＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted in battle, by trashing your top security card, it isn't deleted.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may place 1 [Witchelny] text card from your hand as the bottom security card. Then, by trashing your top security card, 1 of your Digimon may attack.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When your security stack is removed from, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -6000 DP for the turn. Then, if you have 3 or fewer security cards, delete 1 of their 6000 DP or lower Digimon.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When your security stack is removed from, this Digimon may unsuspend.
